labels.notes: Read against benzecri1960_ch1.tex l.80-105 and the scan (PDF p. 4 = journal p. 231). The transcription and the docstring's > quote both match the scan word for word. SENTENCE 1, AFFINE HALF. resultB_poche_aff assumes any simply connected covering pi : N -> V of a compact T2 locally affine V, with pi a morphism, and a pocket (P, phi, z) on N (IsPocheAff, Ch. 2 Def. 1). It gives a compatible chart phi' with source univ, so N is identified with the open set phi'.target. It also gives EqOn phi' phi P, Convex R phi'.target for a shell, and no line for a strict shell. resultB_premiere_aff specialises it to UniversalCover V v0 through revetement_universel_divisible_aff. Lean >= paper: no added hypothesis; V needs neither connectedness nor second countability. ResultBAffPrinted drops the two extras (EqOn, no line). It is exactly the affine half as printed, over Hausdorff, connected, second-countable, compact V : Type. The readings « s'identifie a » (a compatible chart with source W) and « un convexe » (Convex R = IsAffConvex) are disclosed and neutral. THE ASSEMBLY. theoremB conjoins resultB_premiere_aff, resultB_premiere_proj, resultB_deuxieme (every n) and resultB_troisieme (under 0 < n), over V : Type u, unchanged. Each conjunct is >= its sentence. ResultBPrinted n = ResultBAffPrinted n /\ ResultBProjPrinted n /\ ResultBTroisiemePrinted n. That is all three sentences as printed, up to the disclosed readings. One caveat: ResultBTroisiemePrinted (strict, inherited) reads « a une projection non bornee » as « a projection exists and every one is unbounded ». That is equivalent to the literal existential form, since projections are unique up to GA(n). resultBPrinted_iff : ResultBPrinted n <-> 0 < n is fair. Its -> direction refutes only sentence 3 at n = 0, and the literal existential form fails there too: resultB_isBounded_dim_zero bounds every map into R^0. Its docstring says that sentences 1-2 hold in every dimension. MARK. Correctly absent. No bold backticked label occurs anywhere in the file; tools/ledger.py's regex finds none in the first 4000 characters. Under OQ-45 (a), resultBPrinted (0 < n -> ResultBPrinted n) is the printed statement in every dimension the paper then covers, and theoremB is >= it. So the row is marked by flipping the docstring (l.11-13) with no declaration change. Under any other ruling the row stays partial on the n = 0 finding, which is correct (V = R^0 is a compact, T2, connected, second-countable point). PROOF-TERM WALK (kb/0047). Re-run independently on a /tmp copy, now deleted. It walked Expr.getUsedConstants over types and values, allowOpaque, from 10 roots: theoremB, resultB_poche_aff, resultB_premiere_aff, ResultBAffPrinted, resultBAffPrinted, ResultBPrinted, resultBPrinted, resultBPrinted_iff, both witnesses. It watched 67 names: the block's 8; every other affine 1°c declaration of PremierAffine.lean (l.436 on) and TheoremeAffine.lean (isCoqueAff_iff_convex_range_affine, isCoqueStricteAff_iff_range_affine, isPreconnected_inter_range_of_coque_affine, poche_eq_preimage_of_coque_affine, theoreme_poche_balayable_affine*, the Composante/Literal printed forms and .literal); the projective 1°c names of Developpement.lean and Theoreme.lean (OQ-71); PremierFull.lean's full-form names (OQ-79); and OQ-61's strict forms (IsPocheProj.septieme_propriete_of_ne_zero/_of_pos, IsPocheProj.ligne_brisee_poche_of_ne_zero/_of_pos, septiemeProprietePrinted_iff). 56 are in the environment. The 11 PremierFull names are not in ResultB's import closure at all, so they cannot be reached. RESULT: zero hits from every root. Reached in PremierAffine: only 1°a-1°b (PremierGX.*, exists_chart_poche_affine, injective_of_isDeveloping_of_poche_affine, exists_isDeveloping_eqOn_poche_affine) and Def. 1 / Prop. 7' helpers (IsPocheAff.cote_lt_one, isAffSegment_of_chart, IsPocheAff.forall_compact_smul_subset). Reached in TheoremeAffine: only theoreme_troisieme_affine, theoreme_quatrieme_affine and containsAffLine_range_iff_affine. Incidental reach, all proved lemmas with their hypotheses discharged: the <= forms IsPocheProj.ligne_brisee_poche and septieme_majore (OQ-61 (b)'s statements), pseudoLength_self (1 <= n) and ouvert_plein (0 < r). This agrees with the REPORT. So OQ-75, OQ-79 (and OQ-71, OQ-61, OQ-62) do not reach the row. The mark of bzthm:intro_B waits on OQ-45 (a) alone, and the row's blocked_on can be re-pointed to « OQ-45 (a) (sentence 3 at n = 0) » at graduation. Observation for the master, not a finding: resultB_nonVacuite_aff_dim_zero uses the constant cote 0. A ruling of OQ-61 (a) that redefines Def. 1 in place (non-constant cote) would leave dimension 0 with no pocket at all and break that witness. The Hopf witness (cote x0) and every anchor statement (quantified over all pockets) stay >= paper under either ruling. NON-VACUITY. resultB_nonVacuite_hopf_aff is genuine, with n = 1. V = ]0,inf[ / 2^Z (orbitRel quotient) is shown compact (image of [1,2]), T2 (Mathlib's properly-discontinuous instance), connected (from SimplyConnectedSpace of the convex half-line, haveI'd before use) and second countable (ContinuousConstSMul.secondCountableTopology), and locally affine (hasGroupoid_quotient). pi = Quotient.mk is a covering and an affine morphism, and ]0,inf[ is simply connected. The strict shell has P != univ (phi(P) = ]0,1[) and the non-constant cote x0. The conclusion adds an unbounded projection. The general-covering route (kb/0043) is disclosed in SCOPE. It is adequate: UniversalCover V v0 is an instance of the covering form through revetement_universel_divisible_aff, and resultB_nonVacuite_aff_dim_zero shows that IsPocheAff/IsCoqueStricteAff are satisfiable on UniversalCover itself. That dimension-0 witness is disclosed as degenerate (P = W, cote 0), and R^0 is indeed connected (a point).

summary: Faithful and unmarked as it must be: every statement is Lean >= paper, ResultBPrinted is result B as printed up to the disclosed readings, resultBPrinted_iff is fair, and theoremB/resultBPrinted mark the row under OQ-45 (a) with a docstring-only change. The independent proof-term walk (67 watched names) is clean, so the mark waits on OQ-45 (a) alone. It builds with warningAsError, has 0 sorry and only standard axioms, and the two lake builds rebuilt only this module. Scope is clean and the non-vacuity is genuine. Three minor findings: a line reference, a checklist tag, and a disclosed process deviation.
